div.h1: Quote to cash, without the friction.
div.p: Configurable pricing, approval gates, eSignature, fulfilment, and subscription billing, one system. Retire Salesforce CPQ + Zuora + DocuSign + NetSuite.

div.a: Map your sales workflow in Odoo

figure.aria-label: Sales-order pipeline with quotations, approvals tray, customer portal

img.alt: Sales-order pipeline with quotations, approvals tray, customer portal

div.p: Sales management, configured for Afghan operations: multi-currency (AFN, USD), local-tax setup, Dari/Pashto-capable data, sanctions-aware procurement controls, and donor-reporting templates aligned to common Afghan-program requirements. Implemented in Kabul, supported regionally.

ul.li: 500,000-employee Odoo HR engagement for a national government
Jobs.af, Afghanistan's largest job-hunting platform, built by NETLINKS
Clients include Da Afghanistan Bank, Afghanistan Payments System, AKDN, World Bank, UNDP

div.h2: The real cost of a fragmented sales stack.

div.p: The average mid-market B2B stack runs CRM, CPQ, contract management, billing, commissions, and an ERP, each $10-60K/year, with integration work that costs more than the tools and breaks on every major update.

Odoo Sales + Subscriptions + eSignature + Accounting + Commissions + Inventory covers 85-90% of that stack at a fraction of the cost, one database, zero integration overhead. Consolidation typically saves $40-150K/year and frees up 0.5-1 FTE of rev-ops time.

article.p: Multi-level flows with Slack and email.
Tiered plans, split credit, payout reporting.

div.h3: Pricing rules that match how you really sell.
div.p: Discounts by channel, region, volume, customer tier, bundle. We encode your real pricing logic so reps stop negotiating from spreadsheets and approvals run automatically inside defined thresholds.

ul.li: Product configurator for bundled and engineered offerings
Dynamic pricing, volume tiers, customer prices, region taxes
Approval matrix tied to discount thresholds

img.alt: CPQ-driven quote, receipt, autonomous reporting, vendor credit note

div.p: B2B SaaS, embedded approvals and eSignature.
Distributor retired Salesforce CPQ + DocuSign + Zuora.
Services firm, 21% to 33% after faster quote turnaround.

div.h2: Is this the right sales stack for you?

li.span: B2B companies with multi-stage sales processes and approvals
Organizations with complex pricing (tiered, channel, bundled)
Companies tired of maintaining CRM + CPQ + billing + ERP integrations
Enterprise B2B with dozens of pricing dimensions and deep approval chains
Companies needing very specialized CPQ (dynamic product configuration in manufacturing)
Organizations with mature Salesforce CPQ deployments they're happy with
Teams that want aggressive AI-driven deal-scoring and conversation coaching

div.h2: How we deliver Odoo, structured, rehearsed, rollback-tested.
div.p: Every Odoo engagement we take on runs through the same seven-phase delivery methodology, structured discovery, parallel configuration and data migration, rehearsed cutovers with tested rollback paths, role-based training, and 4-8 week hypercare. Refined across 50+ implementations including one of our largest engagements to date.

summary.span: Can you support complex B2B pricing?

details.div: Yes, tiered volume pricing, customer-specific price lists, channel pricing, region-based taxes, bundled product configurators, and currency-specific price lists. We've implemented pricing with hundreds of dimensions without turning it into spaghetti.

summary.span: Does it work for subscription businesses?

details.div: Yes. Odoo Subscriptions covers recurring billing, proration on upgrades and downgrades, add-ons, MRR/ARR reporting, and automatic dunning for failed payments. Integrates with Stripe, Authorize.net, and regional processors for card-on-file. For sophisticated proration edge cases (multi-element arrangements under ASC 606) we sometimes extend with custom logic or integrate Zuora for the revenue recognition layer.

summary.span: What about field sales and reps on the road?

details.div: The Odoo mobile app has full quote entry, customer lookup, product catalog, and pipeline. Reps can configure quotes and capture signatures on site. Works offline with sync on reconnection.

Odoo handles tiered commission plans, split credits across reps and overlays, kickers and accelerators, and payout timing. For more sophisticated compensation design (SPIFFs, quota attainment clawbacks, complex team hierarchy) we extend the native module or integrate dedicated tools like Xactly.

The native Odoo eSignature covers standard signature flows, multiple signers, signature blocks, and legally-enforceable audit trails. For some regulated use cases (real estate, healthcare consents) we integrate DocuSign at the signing step while keeping the quote and contract records in Odoo.

For a 30-rep B2B sales team with migration from existing tools, 2-3 integrations (payment, shipping, accounting), and standard approval workflows: 10-16 weeks. Complex CPQ configuration or subscription billing add scope.

div.p: 30-min sales-stack call. We map your CPQ, eSign, fulfilment, and billing in Odoo, and quote what consolidation takes.
A global technology partner for Odoo ERP implementation, custom software development, AI automation, and digital transformation.
